lines.zh: 长剑比短剑重，步子要稳。
lines.en: A spatha outweighs a gladius; the step must be steady.

lines.zh: 圆盾挂在左臂上，随步晃。
lines.en: The round shield rides my left arm as I walk.
I walk out of the field army's ranks.
This harness is lighter; I move quicker.

lines.zh: 我沿着城墙外沿巡过去。
lines.en: I patrol along the outside of the wall.
The wind snaps my cloak.

lines.zh: 后面的人跟紧我的脚印。
lines.en: Those behind me keep to my footprints.
Even strides keep the formation clean.
Walking, I test the blade's balance.
This road ends at the pass.
I wipe the old nicks on my blade.
The studs of the round shield catch the light.
I am thinking how to array this fight.
That smoke is not from a cook fire.
My fingers run along the blade's ridge.
It is too quiet here.
I look up at the wall.
Comrades on my left; the right is empty.
I sweep the cloak off my shoulder.
Waiting on orders is the hardest part.

lines.zh: 我把剑横在膝上歇一歇。
lines.en: I lay the blade across my knee and rest.

lines.zh: 圆盾边沿有一道旧缺口。
lines.en: There is an old notch in the shield's rim.
The wind here carries wet earth.

lines.zh: 我抬起脚，活动了下脚踝。
lines.en: I lift a foot and roll the ankle.

lines.zh: 一百步外有只鸟飞起来。
lines.en: A bird lifts off a hundred paces away.
Standing still tires me more than marching.
You do not stand like a local.
I look at your scabbard.
You came all this way alone?
Your hands have no calluses.

lines.zh: 盾牌微微抬起，等你先动。
lines.en: My shield lifts slightly, waiting for you.
Tell me who you are first.
Where did that armor come from?
You are standing on my patrol line.

lines.zh: 我看你，也看着你的影子。
lines.en: I watch you and your shadow.
This is not a road you should walk.

lines.zh: 你腰上挂的东西太重了。
lines.en: You carry too much at your belt.
Your face goes on my shield.
I dip my head and swallow the pain.
These old bones still hold.
That one cut deep.
Blood seeps through my armor seams.
Blood runs into my sleeve; I ignore it.
The pain leaves my ears ringing.
I brace the shield against the ground.
At my age, wounds mend slowly.

lines.zh: 这一下我记住了你的手法。
lines.en: Now I know how you strike.
I will not kneel before you.
Set the food down and step back slowly.
There is still salt on that bread.
The field kitchen is just behind me.
I will give the wounded first.
It smells like home baking.
My stomach is growling loud.
Do not rush me; I eat slowly.
One hot bite is worth half a day's march.
Keep a little for yourself too.
That smell has made me careless.
Did you bump me on purpose?
My spatha, with a round shield.
The shield is between us; you will not pass.

lines.zh: 甲片撞在一起，声音很脆。
lines.en: The armor rings sharply when it meets.
I do not shift at all.

lines.zh: 脚下的石缝差点绊到我。
lines.en: A crack in the stones nearly tripped me.
Clear the way; I am on patrol.
My cloak snags, I wheel around.
Do not come at me from behind.
I angle aside to let you pass.

lines.zh: 我这年纪，早过了谈这个。
lines.en: At my age that talk is behind me.
Someone at home is waiting for me.

lines.zh: 军营里的规矩比情分硬。
lines.en: Camp rules are harder than affection.
Service first; the rest later.

lines.zh: 我把这些事锁在箱子里。
lines.en: I keep such things locked in a chest.
You speak too freely.

lines.zh: 同袍会拿这个笑我半年。
lines.en: My comrades would laugh about it for half a year.

lines.zh: 我的婚事在成军之前就定了。
lines.en: My marriage was settled before I joined.
The sword is far simpler than this.
I do not mean to discuss it here.
What falls belongs to the legion.
This one is well made.
I pick it up and stow it in a pouch.
It is logged first, then issued.
Whose is it? If none claim it, it is mine.
I lift it on the point of my blade.
This could patch a shield.

lines.zh: 我在路上捡了不少东西。
lines.en: I have picked up plenty on the road.
Anything useful should not lie there.
I flatten it and tuck it in my belt.
You are inside my patrol zone.
Halt; hands off your weapon.

lines.zh: 长剑出鞘，圆盾转到身前。
lines.en: My spatha clears its sheath, round shield forward.
The iron studs of my round shield face you.
There is one target here.

lines.zh: 我往前一步，你能看见剑。
lines.en: I take a step and let you see the blade.
Shield up, spatha at my side.
I do not need to call for help.
Did you leave yourself a way out?
I looked; there is none.
I have fought this fight many times.

lines.zh: 奇怪，你身上没有军旗味。
lines.en: Strange; you carry no smell of a standard.
I raise the blade; you should withdraw.
Your eyes are hunting my sword.
Stop looking; it is fast.
You are already inside my reach.

lines.zh: 我看你握剑的姿势就知道。
lines.en: The way you hold that blade tells me enough.

lines.zh: 这一带的地面我踩过百遍。
lines.en: I have walked this ground a hundred times.
I circle half a step without turning the blade.
I count your steps as I close in.
I wait for you to lift your hand.
The round shield blocks your view.
The spatha's gift is reach.
You cannot get in and cannot get out.

lines.zh: 我把剑尖压在你胸口前方。
lines.en: I hold the point at chest height.
Back up again and you are at the wall.
Shield and spatha, I hold the line.
You will tire by the third exchange.
I do not swing at air.
My feet never stop moving.
You have changed stance.
It will not help; I can read it.
I probe your hand with the shield rim.
You glanced behind you once.
There is no rescue behind you.
I herd you toward the stone steps.
Those steps will catch your heel.
I wait patiently for your mistake.

lines.zh: 长剑劈下，落在你的盾上。
lines.en: The spatha comes down on your shield.
I slam the shield into your face first.
The edge cuts down at an angle.
This thrust relies on arm length.

lines.zh: 你挡住第一下，挡不住第二下。
lines.en: You stop the first; not the second.

lines.zh: 我压住你的武器，再抽剑。
lines.en: I pin your weapon and pull the blade free.

lines.zh: 剑尖在你胸前画了一道。
lines.en: The point draws a line across your chest.
I step in; the blade turns with my waist.
The shield rim strikes your collarbone.
I have drilled this strike for twenty years.

lines.zh: 你抬盾的瞬间，剑就到了。
lines.en: The instant you raise the shield, the blade arrives.
I cut at your legs, not your armor.
The flat of the blade skates off your bracer.
I jab your jaw with the pommel.
My spatha chops down on your shield rim.
This one aims at your grip.

lines.zh: 野战军到了，我就是前锋。
lines.en: The field army is here; I am its vanguard.

lines.zh: 我把圆盾从背上解下来。
lines.en: I take the round shield off my back.
A post should stand here.

lines.zh: 长剑出鞘，声音比短剑长。
lines.en: The spatha clears its sheath with a longer ring.
I take in the surrounding ground.
Form up and count off.

lines.zh: 这一批人里我资历最老。
lines.en: I am the senior man in this batch.
The pass still holds, so the road is open.
I came from the far side of the wall.
I polished these plates last night.
No one is permitted to fall back.
Standing here, I am the boundary.
I know the road ahead.
This fight must not run past dark.

lines.zh: 我听见后面有人在整队。
lines.en: I hear the men forming up behind me.

lines.zh: 披风太碍事，我甩到后面。
lines.en: The cloak gets in the way; I throw it back.
The wind comes from this side; it favors me.
I bring the blade to shoulder height.
The standard is planted in the dirt behind me.
I hold this line.

lines.zh: 火在披风上烧，我扯掉它。
lines.en: Fire catches my cloak; I tear it away.

lines.zh: 我从石阶上滚下去，剑没脱手。
lines.en: I roll down the steps still holding the blade.

lines.zh: 水灌进甲里，我抓着盾往下沉。
lines.en: Water fills my armor; I sink gripping the shield.
The blast throws me against the wall.

lines.zh: 箭射进盾里，震得我手臂发麻。
lines.en: The arrow buries in the shield and numbs my arm.

lines.zh: 那股力气把我的剑压弯了。
lines.en: That force bends my blade aside.

lines.zh: 三天只喝水，我举剑都费劲。
lines.en: Three days on water alone; even lifting the sword is work.

lines.zh: 雷从剑上过，我的膝盖一软。
lines.en: Lightning crosses the blade and my knees buckle.

lines.zh: 脚下一空，我抓住盾的边缘。
lines.en: The ground drops away; I grab the shield's rim.
